description: This is an initialization file (__init__.py) for the 'portion' package, which primarily re-exports classes, constants, and functions from various modules within the package. It defines the public API of the package and references multiple internal modules related to interval arithmetic and data structures.

classes.name: Bound
classes.description: Enumeration or class providing interval boundary constants (CLOSED, OPEN).

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Class representing an interval, used for interval arithmetic.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Function to iterate over interval data or values.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Function to parse interval data from string representation.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Function to convert interval data to string representation.

methods.name: from_data
